summary: Iteration 12 — FIX-ROUND verification of the 6 defects/action items from iteration_11.json. New suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_fixes.py = 48/48 PASS (run with `-n 0`). (1) Palettes are now separated: Ledger/Reconciliation 'Colour key — owner' lists ONLY the 4 owner names (no flat numbers, no 'Flat NNN'), while Tanker Purchases AND Charges each carry their own 'Colour key — fronted by' block listing 'Flat 101/102/201/202'; owner-label set and payer-label set are disjoint and all tints inside each key are unique. (2) Generated tints verified at scale: created a scratch building 'ZZ QA Scratch Iter12' with 12 flats / 12 distinct owners — the owner colour key has 12 entries with 12 DISTINCT tints and every data row's fill matches (no modulo wrap at 10 any more; _HUES has 30 hues). (3) Meter tints are keyed on meter id: two meters with the IDENTICAL label 'QA Dup Label 7' on two different flats get two different fills (FBF3CF vs CFFBE4) and the 'Colour key — meter' block prints the label verbatim twice. (4) Format validation: GET /api/mis/export rejects bogus/xls/PDF(uppercase)/empty/html with 400 and still returns 200 with the right content-type for csv/pdf/xlsx; GET /api/annual/export rejects bogus/xls AND xlsx with 400 (csv|pdf only, both 200); GET /api/rentals/export rejects bogus/xls/doc with 400 and serves csv/pdf/xlsx 200. (5) Month validation: 'bad', '2026-13', '2026-00', '202608', '2026-8', '' all return 400 on GET /api/mis/export and GET /api/statement. Read-only calls no longer create periods — 3x (statement + mis/export xlsx + overview) for the data-less month 2029-11 on Sunrise Residency left the period list byte-identical (2026-07, 2026-08 only, verified again at the end of the run); writing endpoints still create periods (POST /api/charges on a fresh month 2029-12 created it) and locked periods still reject writes with 423. (6) Charges sheet now has frozen panes (D6) plus the fronted-by colour key; all 5 MIS sheets are frozen, sheet list/navy 1F3864 bold-white headers/2 blue section bands/2 shaded TOTAL rows + 'Per head'/currency formats/DD-MM-YYYY are unchanged. Month close & carry-forward re-verified end to end on a second scratch building (2 flats, 2 meters, readings, tanker+tips, recurring charge, payment): POST /api/periods/reset locked 2027-05, carry_in equals each row's net, 2027-06 statement shows the same carry_in per flat, meter openings carried (1100/700), locked month still readable via /api/statement and xlsx export, second reset -> 423. PaymentIn.direction is now Literal-constrained (direction='bogus' -> 422). Regression: test_iter9 + test_iter10 + test_iter11 + test_auth_playbook = 72/72 GREEN (the two iteration-11 red-flag tests, test_ledger_colour_key_lists_only_owners and test_unknown_format_silently_returns_pdf, now pass). Frontend (Playwright, public preview URL, admin@societyhub.com): login -> mode select -> Maintenance; /mis downloads Excel 13,184 B / CSV 1,913 B / PDF 6,097 B; /rentals/report downloads xlsx 10,021 B / csv / pdf; Water and Charges tab switching works, Reconciliation month-close dialog opens and cancels cleanly, rentals Collections form exposes mode + reference inputs; Properties workspace month switcher changes the whole workspace (2026-06 -> Reports header 'June 2026', to-collect 49,500 and properties-2026-06.xlsx download). /reconcile /water /charges /setup /annual /overview /rentals /rentals/units /rentals/bills /rentals/collections /rentals/payouts all render with ZERO console or page errors. All scratch buildings/flats/meters deleted; no junk period documents left behind.

minor.issue: COSMETIC: the single shared `payers` palette is dumped in full by colour_key(), so the Charges sheet's 'Colour key — fronted by' lists 'Flat 102' even though flat 102 fronts no charge (it only appears on the Tanker sheet). Filter the key to the keys actually used on that sheet, or state it is a workbook-wide legend.

COSMETIC: `payers` and `meters_pal` are both built from X.METER_TINTS, so 'Flat 101' (payer) and 'Meter 101' (meter) end up with the identical fill FBF3CF across sheets — a reader may think the colours are linked. Consider a third hue offset for payers.

STILL OPEN (iter 8/9/11, accepted by design): prev_outstanding() master fallback shows a previous-month due for a unit with no lease dates — legacy tests test_iter6/test_iter7/test_iter8 still assert the old behaviour.

issues: Pre-existing (iter10/11): the 15-column reconciliation table is 1958px inside a 1582px container at 1920px viewport; overflow-x is 'auto' so scrolling works but there is no visible affordance (fade/arrow), the 'Balance to pay / receive' and 'Status' columns are cut off.

design_issues.screen: Water / Charges forms, rentals month switcher
issues: Pre-existing: native input type=date / type=month instead of the shadcn calendar component.

Minor: rentMonth lives only in React state (AppContext useState), so a browser reload / direct deep-link resets the month to the current month — the selected month is not persisted (propertyId behaves the same way).

action_items: Optional cosmetic: scope each sheet's 'Colour key — fronted by' to the payers actually shown on that sheet (Charges currently lists Flat 102 from the Tanker sheet).
Optional cosmetic: give the payer palette its own hue offset so a payer flat tint never equals a meter tint.
xlsx.Palette still wraps with modulo after 30 keys (a >30-unit building would silently reuse a tint) — add an assertion/log or extend the hue walk dynamically.
xlsx._tints() takes an unused `sat=0.16` parameter (saturation is hard-coded 0.85 in the hls_to_rgb call) — remove or wire it up.
server.py is now 1353 lines — move build_mis_workbook (~150 lines) into xlsx.py or a reports module (>700-line guideline).

Legacy data-dependent suites still red (pre-existing, first reported in iteration 9): backend_test.py::TestTipsInWaterCost::test_demo_property_expected_figures and TestMISExport::test_csv, test_media_notify.py::TestStatementNotify::test_rows_expose_phones_and_math (all hard-code the old Sunrise figures 3950/6500 and pick periods[0]=2026-07 which is an empty month), plus test_iter6/test_iter7/test_iter8 rentals carry assertions. Either refresh those expectations or mark them as data-dependent; they are NOT regressions from this round.
critical_code_review_comments: All 4 functional fixes are implemented correctly and cleanly: valid_month()/valid_format() are shared helpers, read_period() is genuinely non-mutating, build_statement(ensure=False) is used by /api/statement, mis_export and the overview only, and meter fills use meter_id with the label carried in Palette.labels.
Palette.labels defaulting to str(key) means a missing label silently prints a Mongo ObjectId in a colour key — pass label explicitly everywhere (currently done, but worth a guard).
colour_key() iterates the whole palette regardless of sheet, so key blocks depend on sheet build order (Charges shows Flat 102 because the Tanker sheet is built first).

success_rate.backend: 100% (48/48 new iteration-12 tests; 72/72 iter9+iter10+iter11+auth regression). 6 pre-existing data-dependent legacy failures unchanged.
success_rate.frontend: 100% (6 export downloads, 11 pages, tab/dialog/month-switcher interactions, zero console errors)

seed_data_creation: Two temporary scratch buildings created via the API and fully deleted at teardown: 'ZZ QA Scratch Iter12' (12 flats / 12 owners / 2 same-label meters, 1 TEST_iter12 charge in 2029-12) and 'ZZ QA Close Iter12' (2 flats, 2 meters, readings, 1 tanker, 1 charge, 1 payment, month 2027-05 closed then the whole property dropped). Verified afterwards: only 'Sunrise Residency' and 'Srinithi Apartments' remain and Sunrise still has exactly periods 2026-07 + 2026-08 (no junk periods created by the read-only export probes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run new suite: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter12_fixes.py -n 0` (48 tests). Regression: tests/test_iter9_report_formats.py tests/test_iter10_recon_layout.py tests/test_iter11_xlsx_export.py tests/test_auth_playbook.py -n 0 = 72/72. Do NOT trust absolute-amount assertions in backend_test.py / test_media_notify.py / test_iter6-8 — they hard-code figures from earlier seeds (Sunrise 2026-08 is now 8450 water / 8500 recurring, and periods[0] is the EMPTY month 2026-07). Reads are now safe: GET /api/statement, /api/mis/export and /api/overview no longer create period documents, so probing arbitrary months is fine; only writing endpoints and POST /api/periods/reset create/lock periods. Excel layout notes: the TOTAL label is NOT in column 1 (Recon D, Meters E, Tankers C, Charges C, Ledger D); the meter label is column 5 on the Water Usage sheet. Colour key blocks are workbook-wide per palette, so the Charges 'fronted by' key includes payers seen on the Tanker sheet. Frontend: the rentals month switcher only renders in Properties mode and resets on a hard reload — switch modes with data-testid=switch-mode-btn and navigate via sidebar links, not page.goto.
rca_of_the_issue: No new defects. Iteration-11 root causes are all closed: (a) build_mis_workbook now builds three palettes (owners for owner rows/Ledger, payers for tanker+charge 'fronted by', meters_pal keyed on meter_id) so flat numbers no longer pollute the owner colour key; (b) OWNER_TINTS/METER_TINTS are generated from a 30-hue HSL walk so >10 owners keep unique tints; (c) valid_format()/valid_month() raise 400 on the three export endpoints; (d) read_period() + build_statement(ensure=False) make GET /api/statement, /api/mis/export and /api/overview non-mutating, so read traffic can no longer manufacture period documents while writes still call ensure_period(); (e) Charges sheet gained freeze_panes + its own colour key. Remaining items are cosmetic (palette legend scoping / hue overlap) or previously accepted by design.
